headline: Violet Hensley Dies at 109; Ozarks Fiddler Made Opry Debut at 99
context: She performed old-time mountain music at the Silver Dollar City theme park in Branson, Mo., for more than 50 years and appeared on “The Beverly Hillbillies.”
